apps.name: Ammy
apps.localizedDescription:
Ammy reads what you're playing in Apple Music — title, artist, album, cover art and the live playback position — and POSTs it as JSON to an HTTPS endpoint you choose. It keeps reporting while the screen is off and while other apps are in front: an update on every track change, and a heartbeat every 30 seconds.

BUILT TO PAIR WITH ISSUN, and not limited to it. Ammy has no opinion about what receives the data — anything that accepts an HTTPS POST works.

AMMY IS A SENDER, NOT A DESTINATION. On its own it does nothing: you need something running at the other end to point it at. Setup on the phone is an address and an optional key, and nothing else. Read the repo first.

Requires iOS 26 or later, and permission to read your media library.

versions.localizedDescription:
Call every failure notice Connection Failed

The popup and the notification were titled Ammy Stopped for what is always the connection failing, which read like the app had died (a separate event with its own notice). Both now say Connection Failed, with the specific reason underneath when there is one. A 5xx from something in front of the receiver (Funnel's 502 when nothing is listening) also says Connection Failed instead of blaming the receiver, and the receiver's own 5xx says Receiver Error, not Relay Error, keeping user-facing text receiver-agnostic.
